content:
When trying to download cache or the latest lean version, I get errors like

error during download info: caused by: [6] Could not resolve hostname (Could not resolve host: github.com)

Is this just a problem with my internet connection, or is it more serious? (Pushing to a branch on my fork seems to be working.)

nslookup gives

$ nslookup github.com
Server:         192.168.1.1
Address:        192.168.1.1#53

Non-authoritative answer:
Name:   github.com
Address: 140.82.121.3
;; Got SERVFAIL reply from 192.168.1.1
** server can't find github.com: SERVFAIL
